subject: Request: trial runway extension & temporary credits due to integration backlog
messages:
From: Ava Linton <ava.linton@finova.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial extension request — integration backlog affecting POC

Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the quantization profiles. We kicked off the connector work earlier this month, and unfortunately our integration sprint hit a few unexpected blockers in the payments schema and SSO handshake.

We're still committed to the POC, but engineering needs more time to get the connector stable. Two asks:

- Can Redwood provide a short extension to the trial window (we're asking for +30 days) so our QA cycles finish before the trial ends?
- Can you add a temporary sandbox credit allocation (around 3,000,000 tokens worth) so we can continue internal end-to-end tests while we finish the integration?

I've attached our integration plan and a short timeline (finova-integration-plan-2026-08.pdf). Happy to share more details in a quick sync if helpful.

Appreciate any flexibility — this POC is strategically important for our payments roadmap.

Best,
Ava Linton
CTO | Finova
ava.linton@finova.io
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: finova-integration-plan-2026-08.pdf (PDF, 220kb)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Linton <ava.linton@finova.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration backlog affecting POC

Ava — thanks for the note and for sending the plan. I read through the attachment and the timeline looks reasonable.

We can absolutely support an extension — a couple pragmatic options I want to outline so we get you unblocked quickly:

1) Immediate sandbox top-up: we can provision an interim token allocation (I recommend 2.5M tokens to start) so your QA team can run E2E tests this week.
2) Trial window extension: we can add a 30-day extension to the current trial if we have a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out key milestones and a go/no-go date.

I attached a one-page MAP draft (rdw-map-draft-jonas-v1.pdf) with suggested checkpoints and a proposed success criteria. If that looks good to you I can get the finance & ops sign-off and push the sandbox credit immediately.

Would you be available for a 20-minute call today or tomorrow to align? If you prefer, reply with any edits to the MAP.

Thanks — 
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0221

Attachment: rdw-map-draft-jonas-v1.pdf (PDF, 18kb)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial extension request — integration backlog affecting POC

Forwarding Ava's ask. Quick notes for approvals:

- I support the 30-day extension conditional on the MAP being agreed and signed by both sides. We should include an acceptance milestone to avoid indefinite open-ended extensions.
- For temporary credits: Finance will approve a one-time sandbox credit up to 3M tokens for strategic prospects; if we give full amount upfront, ask for commitment to the MAP.

Jonas — please confirm the exact token amount you plan to provision now (suggest 2.5M immediate, 500k reserve on milestone). Ben — can you pre-approve the sandbox credit in our internal portal so Jonas can push it once Ava signs the MAP? I'll draft the exchange email to Finance if needed.

—Marissa
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration backlog affecting POC

Jonas / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the MAP. We reviewed the draft and are aligned with the checkpoints; I attached a one-line acceptance (signed_by_ava.pdf) — we can use the milestone cadence you suggested.

We accept the 30-day extension. For the credits, could you provision 2.5M tokens now and hold 500k to be released after the SSO handshake passes QA? We want to make sure the immediate tests run without interruption.

If you can confirm the credit provisioning and extension in writing, I'll schedule the integration QA run for next week.

Thanks again — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Ava
CTO | Finova

Attachment: signed_by_ava.pdf (PDF, 2kb)
